interpretation: Model-estimated claim fidelity, idea order, ROUGE-L F1 and word-count similarity. Components range from 0 to 1; the weighted final score ranges from 0 to 100. Summary statistics describe chunks; final_score compares the complete texts and is null when evaluation is incomplete. A single matched idea has order agreement 1; no matches have order agreement 0 unless both claim lists are empty. Keep evaluator model, prompts and metric version fixed across runs. These scores are not external factual verification.
